as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The information included in Item 2.02 of this Current Report on Form
8-K, including Exhibit 99.1 attached hereto, is being furnished and shall not be deemed &ldquo;filed&rdquo; for purposes of Section 18
of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the &ldquo;Exchange Act&rdquo;), or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that Section
and shall not be deemed incorporated by reference into any other filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange
Act, except as otherwise expressly stated in such filing.</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: right; margin: 0"><B>Exhibit 99.1</B></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; font-size: 20pt; color: #999999"><B><IMG SRC="image_001.jpg" ALT="" STYLE="height: 1in; width: 225pt"></B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 18pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 3pt; color: #999999"><B>NEWS RELEASE</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 3pt"><B>Contact: </B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 3pt"><B>Dhaval Patel</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 3pt">732.501.9657</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; color: Blue"><U>dhaval.patel@pactivevergreen.com</U></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#9;</FONT>&#9;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>Pactiv Evergreen Reports First Quarter 2021 Financial
Results</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B><I>Solid First Quarter Results Despite a Challenging
Environment</I></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>LAKE FOREST, Ill., (May 5, 2021) &ndash;</B>
Pactiv Evergreen Inc. (&ldquo;Pactiv Evergreen&rdquo; or the &ldquo;Company&rdquo;), today reported results for the first quarter 2021
ended March 31, 2021.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Michael King, Chief Executive Officer of Pactiv
Evergreen, &ldquo;As indicated in our last earnings call, the first quarter was challenging with ongoing headwinds from the impacts of
COVID-19 along with a significant negative weather impact from Winter Storm Uri.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">King continued, &ldquo;We are starting to build
momentum in our Foodservice and Food Merchandising segments with the expectation of near double digit volume recovery for the remainder
of 2021 on a year over year basis. In the quarter, the paper mills within the Beverage Merchandising segment were impacted by the winter
storm and a planned cold mill outage. We expect the second quarter to be a transitory quarter with some near term headwinds followed by
a meaningful recovery in the second half of the year. I am proud of our team and its efforts to manage through these challenging times
while still focusing on delivering excellent service to our customers.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>First Quarter 2021 Financial Highlights:</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>Net Revenues</B> of $1,164 million for the
first quarter of 2021 compared to $1,212 million in the prior year period</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>Net Loss</B> from continuing operations of
$11 million for the first quarter of 2021 compared to net income of $133 million in the prior year period. Net (loss) income from continuing
operations included certain significant and/or unusual items that are not necessarily representative of underlying operational performance
as discussed in more detail below </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>Adjusted
                                            EBITDA</B></FONT><SUP>1</SUP> <FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">from
                                            continuing operations of $77 million for the first quarter of 2021 compared to $145 million
                                            in the prior year period. Adjusted EBITDA<SUP>1</SUP> for the first quarter of 2021 includes
                                            additional costs incurred related to the impact of Winter Storm Uri, the continued impact
                                            from COVID-19 and incremental costs from a cold mill outage </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 3pt 0pt 0pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 9pt"><SUP>1</SUP> Adjusted EBITDA is
a non-GAAP measure. Refer to the discussion on non-GAAP financial measures and reconciliation included in this press release.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>


<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%"><TR><TD STYLE="text-align: center; width: 100%">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%"><TR><TD STYLE="text-align: center; width: 100%">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->


<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>First Quarter 2021 Results</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Net revenues in the first quarter of 2021 were
$1,164 million compared to $1,212 million in the prior year period. The decrease was primarily due to lower sales volume within our Foodservice
and Beverage Merchandising segments, largely due to the unfavorable impact from the COVID-19 pandemic, as well as lower pricing, mainly
due to lower raw material costs passed through to customers and lower pricing in Beverage Merchandising due to the impact of COVID-19.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Net Loss from continuing operations was $11 million
in the first quarter of 2021 compared to net income of $133 million in the first quarter of 2020. The change was primarily driven by higher
significant and/or unusual items including a $76 million change in income taxes primarily attributable to changes in the Company&rsquo;s
valuation allowance associated with deferred interest deductions in the prior year period and lower foreign exchange gains on cash of
$84 million. These items were partially offset by lower interest expense of $60 million driven by lower average debt outstanding in the
current year quarter and lower unrealized losses on commodity derivatives of $16 million. Additionally, underlying operational performance
was impacted by higher manufacturing costs in Beverage Merchandising due to Winter Storm Uri and a planned cold mill outage, higher manufacturing
costs in Foodservice and Food Merchandising, lower volume primarily driven by the impact of COVID-19 and lower pricing, partially offset
by favorable raw material costs, net of lower costs passed through to customers.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Adjusted EBITDA<SUP>1</SUP> was $77 million in
the first quarter of 2021 compared to $145 million in the first quarter of 2020. The decline was primarily due to higher manufacturing
costs in Beverage Merchandising driven by the impact of Winter Storm Uri along with a $16 million impact from a cold mill outage, higher
manufacturing costs in Foodservice and Food Merchandising, lower volume primarily driven by the impact of COVID-19 and lower pricing,
partially offset by favorable raw material costs, net of lower costs passed through to customers. Adjusted EBITDA<SUP>1</SUP> for the
first quarter of 2021 includes $39 million of additional costs incurred related to the impact of Winter Storm Uri.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Key Segment Results (compared to the first quarter
of 2020)</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><I><U>Foodservice</U></I></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">Net revenues decreased $19 million, or 4% to $454
million</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">Adjusted EBITDA increased $5 million, or 9% to
$61 million</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The decrease in net revenues was driven by lower
sales volume primarily due to market contraction from the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The increase in Adjusted EBITDA was primarily driven
by favorable raw material costs, net of the lower costs passed through to customers, partially offset by higher manufacturing costs and
lower sales volume due to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><I><U>Food Merchandising</U></I></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">Net revenues decreased $2 million, or 1% to $342
million</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

driven by lower volume, partially offset by favorable pricing, net of product mix.</P>

by favorable material costs, net of lower costs passed through to customers, and favorable pricing, mostly offset by higher manufacturing
costs.</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The decrease in net revenues was primarily due

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The decrease in Adjusted EBITDA was primarily driven
by $34 million of additional costs incurred due to the impact of Winter Storm Uri and $16 million related to a cold mill outage, production
inefficiencies and lower pricing.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>Outlook</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">While the year is off
to a challenging start, most notably driven by the impacts of COVID-19 and Winter Storm Uri, the Company is seeing volumes beginning to
return to near pre-pandemic levels. Volume recovery is expected to continue in Q2 2021, however, the recent spike in resin prices will
impact margins due to the contractual lag on material price increases. The Company expects to recover from this margin impact over the
coming quarters as contractual pricing resets allow the ability to pass through these increases in resin costs. Additionally, the Company
expects an improved second half of 2021 as the markets in which it operates see increased mobility and economic activity and the Company
realizes benefits from its strategic investment program and other initiatives.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">&nbsp;</P>

the live webcast and supplemental presentation on the Pactiv Evergreen Investor Relations website at https://investors.pactivevergreen.com
under &ldquo;Events.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><B>About Pactiv Evergreen Inc. </B>Pactiv Evergreen
Inc. (NASDAQ: PTVE) is one of the largest manufacturers of fresh food and beverage packaging in North America. With a team of nearly
15,000 employees, the Company produces a broad range of on-trend and feature-rich products that protect, package and display food and
beverages for today&rsquo;s consumers. Its products, many of which are made with recycled, recyclable or renewable materials, are sold
to a diversified mix of customers, including restaurants, foodservice distributors, retailers, food and beverage producers, packers and
processors. Learn more at <FONT STYLE="color: Blue"><U>www.pactivevergreen.com</U></FONT>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; background-color: #FEFEFE"><B>Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; background-color: #FEFEFE">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 32.05pt">The Company uses the non-GAAP
financial measure &ldquo;Adjusted EBITDA&rdquo; in evaluating its past results and future prospects. The Company defines Adjusted EBITDA
as net (loss) income from continuing operations calculated in accordance with GAAP plus the sum of income tax expense (benefit), net interest
expense, depreciation and amortization and further adjusted to exclude certain items of a significant or unusual nature, including but
not limited to foreign exchange gains or losses on cash, goodwill impairment charges, related party management fees, unrealized gains
or losses on derivatives, gains or losses on the sale of businesses and non-current assets, restructuring, asset impairment and other
related charges, operational process engineering-related consultancy costs, non-cash pension income or expense, strategic review and transaction-related
costs and executive transition charges.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 32.05pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 32.05pt">The Company presents Adjusted
EBITDA because it is a key measure used by its management team to evaluate its operating performance, generate future operating plans
and make strategic decisions. In addition, the Company&rsquo;s chief operating decision maker uses Adjusted EBITDA of each reportable
segment to evaluate the operating performance of such segments. Accordingly, the Company believes presenting this metric provides useful
information to investors and others in understanding and evaluating its operating results in the same manner as the management team and
board of directors.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 32.05pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 32.05pt">Non-GAAP information should
be considered as supplemental in nature and is not meant to be considered in isolation or as a substitute for the related financial information
prepared in accordance with GAAP. In addition, the Company&rsquo;s non-GAAP financial measure may not be the same as or comparable to
similar non-GAAP financial measures presented by other companies.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 32.05pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 32.05pt">Please see the reconciliation
of the Company&rsquo;s Non-GAAP measure used in this release to the most directly comparable GAAP measure, beginning on the following
page.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 32.05pt">&nbsp;</P>

                                            asset impairment, restructuring and other related charges (net of reversals) primarily associated
                                            with the remaining closures businesses that are not reported within discontinued operations.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

                                            the non-cash pension income related to the Company&rsquo;s employee benefit plans.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

                                            the costs incurred to evaluate and improve the efficiencies of the Company&rsquo;s manufacturing
                                            and distribution operations.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

                                            the related party management fee charged by the Rank Group Limited to us. Following the Company&rsquo;s
                                            IPO, we are no longer charged the related party management fee.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

                                            costs incurred for strategic reviews of the Company&rsquo;s businesses, as well as costs

                                            foreign exchange gains on cash, primarily on U.S. dollar amounts held in non-U.S. dollar
